QUESTION:
What is the recommended dose of Amoxicillin for pediatric patients?

RESPONSE:
For pediatric patients aged 3 months to 12 years weighing ≤40 kg, the recommended dose of amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium oral suspension (600 mg/42.9 mg per 5 mL) is 90 mg/kg/day of amoxicillin, divided into two doses given every 12 hours, administered for 10 days. The dose should be taken at the start of a meal to minimize gastrointestinal intolerance and enhance clavulanate potassium absorption. A dosage guideline table is provided in the label based on body weight (ranging from 3 mL twice daily for 8 kg patients up to 15 mL twice daily for 40 kg patients). For pediatric patients weighing >40 kg, experience with this formulation is not available. Always shake the suspension well before each use.
